entry.text: Team Size: 12
Role: Senior Business Analyst
Responsibilities
• Collaborated with clients and stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional
requirements, translating them into detailed SRS, FRS, and other key project deliverables.
• Compared current and future state reconciliation processes through Gap Analysis and documented findings
to support solution design.
• Broke down business needs into clear functional requirements, discussed priorities with business owners
and ensured everything was agreed before each sprint.
• Worked on reconciling general ledger and sub ledger month end balances using ReconPro and contributed
to the out of proof functionality which helped the business sign off on ledger accounts.
• Checked stock positions daily to ensure numbers matched across all systems and raised any mismatches
for quick resolution.
• Investigated recurring reconciliation breaks, identified root causes and helped reduce the number of breaks
over time.
• Defined match rule logic in the system to accurately match month end balances across sub ledgers and
reduce reconciliation breaks.
• Worked with developers to schedule and automate data feeds through Business Objects to ensure data
was available on time for month end reconciliation
• Organised sessions with the reporting team to build matched and unmatched reports for business users to
track reconciliation outcomes.
• Broke down requirements into Epics, User Stories and Tasks and estimated effort through Story Point
discussions with the team.
• Ran Sprint Planning and Daily Scrum sessions to keep the team on track and resolved blockers quickly to
avoid delays.
• Worked with the testing team to write and run test cases to ensure reconciliation results were accurate and
complete.
• Logged bugs and risks in JIRA, set priority levels, escalated to stakeholders and tracked until closure.
• Sent regular progress updates to senior management highlighting what was completed, what was pending
and any decisions needed.

entry.text: Team Size: 12
Role: Senior Business Analyst
Responsibilities
• Engaged with business stakeholders to understand their trading and settlement needs and prepared BRDs
and FRDs covering functional specifications, business rules, system interactions and acceptance criteria
• Good understanding of the Securities Trade Lifecycle from Order Initiation and Execution through to
Affirmation, Confirmation, Clearing and Settlement across Equity and Bond instruments in Capital Markets
• Played an active role in Clearing and Settlement requirements covering pay-in and pay-out of funds and
securities and net obligation calculations between counterparties
• Worked closely with SMEs to capture margin calculation rules for Equities, Futures and Options and wrote
them up as functional requirements for the development team.
• Documented MTM valuation requirements to ensure the system correctly revalued open positions on a
daily basis
• Captured Margin Call requirements including initial margin, variation margin and collateral management to
ensure threshold breaches triggered accurate and timely margin calls in the system
• Picked up production issues, raised Change Requests and followed each fix through to successful
deployment
• Tracked defects in JIRA with full details, assigned priority and severity and chased closure with the relevant
teams
• Drove UAT by sitting with business users to walk through test scenarios, validate outcomes and get sign
off before go-live
• Ran Regression Testing checks to confirm that new changes did not break any existing system behaviour
• Walked clients through new features via demos and put together training manuals to help users get up to
speed quickly
• Held Daily Stand-ups to catch blockers early and keep the team moving towards sprint goals
• Used burndown charts to track sprint delivery and kept stakeholders informed on progress and any
emerging risks

entry.text: Team Size: 12
Role: Senior Business Analyst
Responsibilities
• Collaborated with clients and stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional
requirements, translating them into detailed SRS, FRS, and other key project deliverables.
• Compared current and future state reconciliation processes through Gap Analysis and documented findings
to support solution design.
• Broke down business needs into clear functional requirements, discussed priorities with business owners
and ensured everything was agreed before each sprint.
• Worked on reconciling general ledger and sub ledger month end balances using ReconPro and contributed
to the out of proof functionality which helped the business sign off on ledger accounts.
• Checked stock positions daily to ensure numbers matched across all systems and raised any mismatches
for quick resolution.
• Investigated recurring reconciliation breaks, identified root causes and helped reduce the number of breaks
over time.
• Defined match rule logic in the system to accurately match month end balances across sub ledgers and
reduce reconciliation breaks.
• Worked with developers to schedule and automate data feeds through Business Objects to ensure data
was available on time for month end reconciliation
• Organised sessions with the reporting team to build matched and unmatched reports for business users to
track reconciliation outcomes.
• Broke down requirements into Epics, User Stories and Tasks and estimated effort through Story Point
discussions with the team.
• Ran Sprint Planning and Daily Scrum sessions to keep the team on track and resolved blockers quickly to
avoid delays.
• Worked with the testing team to write and run test cases to ensure reconciliation results were accurate and
complete.
• Logged bugs and risks in JIRA, set priority levels, escalated to stakeholders and tracked until closure.
• Sent regular progress updates to senior management highlighting what was completed, what was pending
and any decisions needed.

entry.text: Team Size: 12
Role: Senior Business Analyst
Responsibilities
• Engaged with business stakeholders to understand their trading and settlement needs and prepared BRDs
and FRDs covering functional specifications, business rules, system interactions and acceptance criteria
• Good understanding of the Securities Trade Lifecycle from Order Initiation and Execution through to
Affirmation, Confirmation, Clearing and Settlement across Equity and Bond instruments in Capital Markets
• Played an active role in Clearing and Settlement requirements covering pay-in and pay-out of funds and
securities and net obligation calculations between counterparties
• Worked closely with SMEs to capture margin calculation rules for Equities, Futures and Options and wrote
them up as functional requirements for the development team.
• Documented MTM valuation requirements to ensure the system correctly revalued open positions on a
daily basis
• Captured Margin Call requirements including initial margin, variation margin and collateral management to
ensure threshold breaches triggered accurate and timely margin calls in the system
• Picked up production issues, raised Change Requests and followed each fix through to successful
deployment
• Tracked defects in JIRA with full details, assigned priority and severity and chased closure with the relevant
teams
• Drove UAT by sitting with business users to walk through test scenarios, validate outcomes and get sign
off before go-live
• Ran Regression Testing checks to confirm that new changes did not break any existing system behaviour
• Walked clients through new features via demos and put together training manuals to help users get up to
speed quickly
• Held Daily Stand-ups to catch blockers early and keep the team moving towards sprint goals
• Used burndown charts to track sprint delivery and kept stakeholders informed on progress and any
emerging risks
